main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Counts the total number of subsequences equal to ABC over every possible replacement of each '?' in the input string with 'A', 'B', or 'C', modulo 1000000007." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Declare a character buffer s of size 100005 and read a whitespace-delimited string from standard input into s using scanf. RESULT s]
            [COMMAND Declare long long integer variables i and n, and set n to strlen(s). RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Declare long long arrays ca and cha of size 100005, and initialize ca[0] to 0 and cha[0] to 0. RESULT ca_cha_initialized]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive with increment i++ after each iteration, update ca[i+1] and cha[i+1] based on s[i]: if s[i] is 'A', set ca[i+1] to ca[i]+1 and cha[i+1] to cha[i]; else if s[i] is '?', set ca[i+1] to ca[i] and cha[i+1] to cha[i]+1; otherwise set both ca[i+1] and cha[i+1] to ca[i] and cha[i] respectively. RESULT ca_cha_prefix_counts]
            [COMMAND Declare long long arrays cc and chc of size 100005, and initialize cc[n] to 0 and chc[n] to 0. RESULT cc_chc_initialized]
            [COMMAND For i from n-1 down to 0 inclusive with decrement i-- after each iteration, update cc[i] and chc[i] based on s[i]: if s[i] is 'C', set cc[i] to cc[i+1]+1 and chc[i] to chc[i+1]; else if s[i] is '?', set cc[i] to cc[i+1] and chc[i] to chc[i+1]+1; otherwise set both cc[i] and chc[i] to cc[i+1] and chc[i+1] respectively. RESULT cc_chc_suffix_counts]
            [COMMAND Declare long long constant p equal to 1000000007 and long long ans equal to 0. RESULT p_ans_initialized]
            [COMMAND For i from 0 to n-1 inclusive, if s[i] is 'B' or '?', update ans by adding the modular product of the left-factor (ca[i] * modpow(3, cha[i], p) % p + cha[i] * modpow(3, cha[i] - 1, p) % p) % p and the right-factor (cc[i+1] * modpow(3, chc[i+1], p) % p + chc[i+1] * modpow(3, chc[i+1] - 1, p) % p) % p, then reduce ans modulo p. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Print ans as a decimal long long integer followed by a newline using printf, and return 0 from main. RESULT void]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
